_readme: Don't Miss placements (DEC-025). Order here is the order on the homepage; at most 3 show. Two kinds of entry: an EVENT placement {eventId, eyebrow?, reason?} featuring one existing canonical event (eventId is the id= in its event.html?id=... link; it shows only while that event is current and has an image), or a STATIC EDITORIAL card {title, copy, cta, image, image2x?, alt, focus?} such as the seasonal guides (non-navigating until its page exists). Optional from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) on either kind. Remove an entry to stop featuring it. Selection is editorial only and is never paid for.

placements.title: Detroit Orbit Fall Guide
placements.copy: Cider mills. Pumpkin patches. Orchards. Donuts. Hayrides. Find your fall.
placements.alt: A wooden cider press pouring fresh cider beside baskets of apples and pumpkins, with a red barn and hayride at sunset.

placements.title: Halloween in the Orbit
placements.copy: Haunts. Horror. Ghosts. Oddities. Family fun. Halloween across the Detroit Orbit.
placements.alt: Glowing jack-o'-lanterns and a scarecrow beside a foggy path leading visitors toward a haunted manor under a full moon.

placements.title: Fall Colors
placements.copy: Trails. Parks. Scenic drives. Waterfronts. Find the Detroit Orbit at peak color.
placements.alt: Red and orange autumn maples above a river at sunset, with the Detroit skyline on the horizon.
